results.remarks:
Whispering Pines Lodge. Tucked among towering pines in one of Lake Arrowhead’s most sought-after neighborhoods, this expansive mountain retreat offers the perfect balance of privacy, scale, and timeless cabin charm. Set on a generous ~17,000 sq ft lot, 813 Brentwood Drive backs directly to the National Forest—creating a rare sense of seclusion with no neighbors to the left or behind you. Here, your backyard becomes an extension of the forest, where wildlife wanders through and nature is your daily backdrop.

The main living area is anchored by a cozy fireplace, creating the perfect gathering space for snowy winter evenings or cool summer nights. Large windows frame serene forest views, filling the home with natural light and bringing the outdoors in. The open-concept flow leads seamlessly into the dining area and spacious kitchen—ideal for hosting family and friends after a day on the lake or at the country club.

Retreat to the primary suite where you’ll find a private sanctuary complete with its own fireplace, generous proportions, and a peaceful ambiance that feels worlds away. Additional bedrooms are well-sized and versatile—perfect for guests, a home office, or a growing family.

On the lower level, a dedicated game room creates an entirely separate entertaining experience—perfect for hosting, movie nights, a pool table, or a relaxed lounge space. This additional living area enhances the home’s versatility, offering the ideal setup for kids, guests, or short-term rental potential, all while maintaining privacy from the main living spaces.

This home includes coveted lake rights to Lake Arrowhead, offering access to private beaches, boating, and year-round recreation. Ideally located just minutes from Lake Arrowhead Country Club, it’s a quick golf cart drive to tee off in the morning or enjoy dining and social events in the evening—bringing the full mountain club lifestyle right to your doorstep.

Beyond the property, enjoy the rare convenience of being within walking distance to Grass Valley Park and the lake, where open green space, playgrounds, and peaceful shoreline paths create the perfect setting for morning strolls, family picnics, and sunset walks—an amenity that truly elevates everyday living. The property also features a two-car garage and ample parking.

results.remarks:
Welcome to this exceptional mountain retreat with one-of-a-kind golf course and water views overlooking the second green of Lake Arrowhead Country Club. Panoramic vistas of manicured fairways, tranquil water features, and a picturesque bridge create a peaceful, ever-changing backdrop.

Level-entry access welcomes you into a light-filled interior featuring vaulted beamed ceilings with tongue-and-groove wood accents, a warm brick fireplace, and expansive windows framing the surrounding landscape. The thoughtfully designed main level offers recently updated carpeting, two spacious primary suites, a welcoming great room, a well-appointed kitchen with an adjoining dining area, and a conveniently located laundry room.

An expansive deck extends the living space outdoors, perfect for morning coffee, afternoon sunshine, or relaxing evenings overlooking the golf course.

Upstairs, two additional en-suite bedrooms and a secondary living area provide privacy and flexibility for family and guests. The lower level is designed for entertaining with a game room, bar, lounge, pool table, and an additional bedroom or flexible bonus space.

Outside, the property features a grassy front yard, spacious rear lawn, fenced dog run, and lower patio for outdoor dining. A deep two-car garage and extended driveway provide ample parking. Mature trees and lush landscaping create a private setting.

Ideally located just minutes from Lake Arrowhead's private lake, scenic hiking trails, and the charming mountain village, this exceptional home offers the perfect balance of luxury, recreation, and year-round mountain living. Golf enthusiasts will appreciate the premier course-front setting, while Lake Arrowhead Lake Rights provide access to the private lake, beaches, and exclusive recreational amenities. From boating and paddle boarding to lakeside dining, boutique shopping, and seasonal village events, every day is an invitation to enjoy the coveted Lake Arrowhead lifestyle. For those seeking the ultimate lake experience, a single-slip dock (Dock #S137B), conveniently located near Burnt Mill and the Lake Arrowhead Brewing Company, is available for separate purchase, presenting a rare opportunity to pair an exceptional golf course residence with private boating access.

This is more than a home—it's a rare offering that combines exceptional mountain living, premier golf course frontage, and the opportunity for private boating access, delivering the ultimate lifestyle.

results.remarks: Welcome to Heaven! This Hamiltair Estates Lakefront Lodge is one step closer!  An absolute masterful accomplishment of Modern Craftsman architecture and refined luxury! Situated in Lake Arrowhead's most coveted 24/7 guard gated community with exclusive private shoreline, beach, pickle/tennis membership, private launch ramp, and even concierge services. This stunning family-entertainment lodge is positioned in a prime location at the leeward side of the peninsula, providing serene lake, tree, and sunrise views with exceptional design that is functional and meticulously integrated to perfection.  An impressive porte-cochere front entry flows seamlessly to foyer and a grand great room, showcasing floor to ceiling windows, open beam hand hewn trusses with spectacular hotel scale lighting, an impressive mason wood burning fireplace (one of four), custom french oak flooring, oversized kitchen and dining all extend to over 2000 sf of decking bring the outdoors in! Magnificently curated by Paige Kunkle of Paige Kunkle Designs with touches including a complete palette of Farrow & Ball paint colors, bespoke glazing with bronzed specialty finishes, designer wall coverings from Schumacher, Lee Jofa, Kelly Wearstler and Serena & Lilly. Hand forged iron trim, custom hardware sourced from New York Hardware, lighting and accents by Rejuvenation, Habitat Envy, Restoration Hardware as well vintage pieces from Big Daddy's Antiques. Honored with the National Kitchen & Bath Association's 2024 award for Best Bath Interior Design, outfitted with luxury fixtures from Brizo, Kallista, and Kohler Artifacts collections including a handcrafted soaking tub by MTI. Throughout the home are a variety of hand selected natural stone elements such as petrified wood, dolomite, and exclusive marbles. Every room offers a "Stay a While" invite feel (including the prime all seasons sitting area).  At lake level is a well designed billiard-media room with bar, ice maker and conveniently located to additional deck and spa area.  Enjoy a custom lit path that takes you gracefully to gazebo and dock area in a sheltered position. Other features include automatic blinds, heated bath flooring, recessed and art lighting, 2 laundry rooms, abundant storage, en-suite guest rooms include a children's bunk room, golf cart garage, EV charger, tankless water heaters, Sierra Pacific windows, outdoor fireplace, and more.  When Only the Best Will Do!  You have found it!

results.remarks:
HOUSE WITH 1/2-DOUBLE DOCK! Hidden behind the gates of North Shore Estates, this extraordinary mountain lodge was built to be felt as much as it is seen. From the moment you arrive, the artistry and craftsmanship are undeniable — hand-selected wood finishes, dramatic custom-beamed ceilings, and impeccable hardwood floors create a sense of timeless character rarely found today.

Every room has been thoughtfully designed to bring warmth, comfort, and connection to nature. The heart of the home is the beautifully crafted kitchen and gathering space, where family and friends naturally come together beside the glow of the fireplace. Expansive glass doors open to a breathtaking deck suspended among towering evergreens, where the sounds of rustling trees and birdsong replace the noise of everyday life. This is the kind of peaceful mountain setting people dream about but rarely find.

Adding to the allure, a ½-double dock is located just a couple of minutes’ walk away in the highly sought-after Winter Harbor Cove — offering easy access to unforgettable lake days, sunset cruises, and peaceful mornings on the water. 

Back at home, three stunning fireplaces create warmth and ambiance throughout the residence, while air conditioning ensures year-round comfort. The floor plan offers incredible flexibility with three spacious bedrooms, a charming library or study that could easily become a fourth bedroom, a private sauna, and an expansive bonus room originally designed as a hobby and wardrobe retreat. Whether transformed into an art studio, wellness room, executive office, or additional guest space, the possibilities are endless.

Privately situated on the lower level, the primary suite feels like its own secluded sanctuary. Anchored by a beautiful fireplace, the suite features a luxurious bath, oversized custom closets lined with Cedar, and French doors opening to a lush garden patio surrounded by vibrant greenery — a serene place to enjoy morning coffee or unwind beneath the stars.

This is more than a mountain home. It is a legacy property built with soul, craftsmanship, and intention — a rare opportunity to own a place where memories will be made for generations to come. This home awaits for those who appreciates quality craftmanship and a private setting. Must see to appreciate. Did I say there is a Generator included for your comfort?

results.remarks: A rare opportunity to own a furnished lake-rights home offering beautiful lake views, a coveted dock slip, and a ski boat - a thoughtfully assembled offering designed for effortless enjoyment of the lake. The 3-bed, 3-bath home pairs a beautifully considered layout, abundant natural light, & a seamless connection to the outdoors. A landscaped front garden & distinctive redwood accents create a welcoming first impression, while a 2-car garage, & additional spaces provide ample parking. The garage connects directly to the interior of the home, offering the convenience of coming & going without stepping outside. Adjacent to the garage, a separate bonus space with its own exterior entrance is well suited to a creative studio, gym, workshop, or storage.The main level is bright & inviting, with a spacious living room, well-appointed kitchen, & separate dining area arranged for both everyday living and entertaining. A powder room & laundry add to the functionality of the floor. Large windows draw in natural light, while the living spaces open directly onto the outdoor decks. The first deck extends the dining and entertaining areas outdoors. A second deck leads to the home's most compelling vantage point, where the lake views take center stage. The fully fenced yard provides a private & versatile outdoor setting. Upstairs, 3 bedrooms & 2 bathrooms offer a comfortable separation between the home's living & sleeping areas. The primary suite is spacious with 2 closets, a large bathroom & fireplace. Beyond the residence, the lake offering is what sets this property apart. The dock (MBM 13-1) is in a prime location in the deep waters of sought after Meadow Bay. The dock occupies the first slip on the multi-slip dock closest to the party deck, with a uniquely broad footprint, dock box & built in racks for kayaks. A well maintained 2008 Tige 22VE ski boat is also included. Combined with the home's lake rights, the result is a rare opportunity to step into the lake lifestyle with the most important pieces already in place. The sellers have made thoughtful improvements, including a new HVAC system, smart home system, fresh paint, to name a few & the water heater was replaced in 2021. results.remarks: Experience the perfect blend of mountain warmth and lake-house living in this beautifully renovated Prow-style home, ideally situated in a coveted first-tier location just across the street from the lake (lake rights, of course). With the extensive $600K renovation, the new owners will be the first to occupy the home, enjoying fresh finishes, thoughtful upgrades, and the opportunity to add their own personal touches. A single-slip dock is also available for purchase separately, completing the epitome of living the perfect Lake Arrowhead lifestyle. Step inside to a dramatic Great Room where natural wood-lined, open-beamed cathedral ceilings create the warmth and character expected in a classic mountain-lake retreat. Expansive windows capture beautiful lake views, while a wood-burning fireplace provides an inviting gathering place year-round. The open design flows to an oversized wraparound redwood deck, extending the living and entertaining space outdoors. The home offers three bedrooms, three baths, a spacious loft/game room and a separate lower-level family room—providing plenty of room for family and guests. Most rooms enjoy lake views, reinforcing the home's wonderful connection to the water. The family room features a second wood-burning fireplace and wet bar complete with an icemaker and beverage refrigerator, creating an ideal space for entertaining. Beautiful custom Alder cabinetry adds warmth and craftsmanship throughout the kitchen and hallways. Buyers still have time to personalize select finishing details, including their choice of granite or quartzite kitchen countertop colors, shower-door finishes, and some lighting. Outside, the lower patio offers another inviting entertaining area with a new built-in BBQ and room for a future spa. Parking is unusually generous for a mountain property, with level parking for four vehicles and deep enough for boat parking. Walk directly across the street from the front side to the lake and access to the single-slip dock (available for extra). With its first-tier setting, extensive renovation, lake views, and optional dock, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy a fresh take on the quintessential Mountain-Lake lifestyle.

results.remarks: Tudor Retreat with Panoramic Lake Arrowhead Views. Breathtaking lake views grace this lovingly updated Tudor home. An optional dock purchase in coveted Emerald Bay makes this a true lake lifestyle property. The light-filled living room with soaring ceilings and sweeping lake views opens onto a spacious awning-covered deck ideal for alfresco dining. Generous prep space in the kitchen makes for effortless entertaining and everyday cooking. The main floor primary suite is a private escape, featuring a walk-in closet, a beautifully tiled walk-in shower, and, of course, stunning lake views. Three additional bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bath (another upstairs, two down), offer comfort and privacy for family or guests, with a powder room conveniently located on each level. Downstairs, the entertainment continues with a large game room and wet bar that flows out to a second expansive deck - home to a newly built greenhouse - and a fully fenced backyard great for two or four-legged friends. The newly landscaped low maintenance yard with artificial turf adds extra curb appeal. Some of the recent upgrades include a new Generac generator, tankless water heater, instant under sink hot water, a fully fenced yard and fresh paint throughout. Just minutes from the marina, Tavern Bay and the Lake Arrowhead Village, this lake rights home is truly a unique mountain gem.

All furnishings and artwork are available for purchase, making this incredible home move-in ready.
Look no further—this is the mountain home you’ve been searching for!

results.remarks:
45 Acres of Forest +  Rustic Cabin

Discover a rare opportunity to own approximately 45 acres of land with a cabin conveniently located just off Highway 18 in Lake Arrowhead communities, Skyforest.

Surrounded by mature trees and breathtaking mountain scenery, the expansive property offers exceptional potential. Formerly known as Wylie Woods Retreat and once home to the Old Presbyterian Church Conference Center, the land has a rich and memorable history. According to the seller, the former hotel and lodge structures were destroyed in the 2003 Old Fire, creating an opportunity to reimagine the property for a new era.

The offering consists of three parcels totaling more than 44 acres, with several hundred feet of frontage along Highway 18. Known as Wonderland, the current access is on Sycamore Drive. The property borders Sycamore Drive, part of Green Briar and extends toward Cumberland Road, adjacent to SkyPark at Santa's Village.

Nestled among the trees is a charming rustic cabin with four bedrooms and four bathrooms. Easy access. Come experience the magic of Skyforest and envision what you could create in this exceptional mountain setting. PLEASE NOTE: The cabins sits on 44+ acres consisted of 3 parcels, the $/sf shown is calculated with only one of the smallest parcel.

results.remarks:
Vintage lakefront retreat located in desirable historic neighborhood, just a short stroll to the included dock, water’s edge and local amenities!
Sited beneath a canopy of mature Pines, Cedars, and Dogwoods, this beautifully preserved 1928 lakefront cottage blends timeless character with thoughtful updates—offering the ultimate year-round retreat for family and friends. Ideally located in a sought-after historic neighborhood, you're just a short stroll from your own private ½ double dock, the water’s edge, and beloved local amenities. The home’s inviting exterior features classic wood shingle siding and split granite accents, setting the stage for the warmth and charm found inside. Step into the spacious great room, where vaulted beamed ceilings, a striking red-rock fireplace, and panoramic French doors create a cozy yet expansive living area filled with natural light. These doors open to a stunning stone patio, where a seasonal creek meanders by—perfect for enjoying tranquil mornings or lively gatherings. The open layout seamlessly connects the updated kitchen, main living area, and serene outdoor spaces, making entertaining effortless. A cozy bunkroom with an adjacent bathroom and a separate workshop complete the main level. Up a small staircase is a peaceful bedroom with a charming bay window, along with a full bath. The upper level also offers two additional bedrooms—one a bright guest retreat with vaulted ceilings and skylights, the other an oversized primary suite tucked among the treetops. A fully remodeled bath and a flexible bonus room (ideal as an office, nursery, or den) complete the upper floor. This rare lakefront property features level pathways that lead to your private dock with a metal canopy, sitting area, and beach—just across from the iconic Lone Pine Island. In the opposite direction, the trail quickly leads to Burnt Mill Beach Club, a popular local brewery, and nearby resort. Additional highlights include a whole-house Generac generator, central air conditioning, a well-appointed single-car garage, and parking for 4+ vehicles. A true four-season getaway, this property is a rare opportunity to own a piece of lakefront paradise—blending historic charm with modern comfort in one of the mountain’s most cherished settings.

Welcome to elevated lake living in the exclusive gated community of Meadow Shores, where unmatched privacy meets exceptional design. Nestled amidst towering trees and nature, this meticulously crafted home blends warmth and sophistication from its striking exterior right into its inviting interior. Offering the ultimate lifestyle, this property includes a highly coveted end-slip boat dock just a stroll away, complete with a 21-foot Cobalt Bow Rider Powerboat for your lake adventures. Furnishings are available also for total ease in your new home and adventures.

Step inside through the convenient level entry directly from the garage, where a dramatic, soaring wall of cathedral windows immediately frames the serene outdoor landscape. The main level welcomes you with rich flagstone slate flooring, warm wood accents, a versatile entry-level bedroom or den, and a full bathroom complete with a private shower and sauna. At the heart of the home, a striking double-facing fireplace and a custom wet bar enhance the spacious living room. This space flows seamlessly into an adjoining office and a formal dining room, creating an ideal environment for entertaining. When only the best will do, the chef's delight kitchen delivers with top-tier Thermador appliances, custom cabinetry, granite countertops, and a moveable center island.

A gorgeous custom iron stairway leads to the upper level, revealing a luxurious primary suite featuring a private outdoor deck, a dual-facing fireplace, and a spa-inspired ensuite bathroom equipped with a jetted soaking tub, dual sinks, a separate shower, and a custom closet. Two additional family bedrooms complete the upper level, featuring expansive closets, individual workspaces, private Juliette balconies, and an adjoining Jack-and-Jill bathroom. Step outside to enjoy the multi-sectional Trex decking overlooking a tranquil seasonal stream. Enhanced by modern upgrades including air conditioning, a tankless water heater, new carpet, and exterior paint, this exceptional property truly exemplifies love and pride of ownership. Elevated living at its finest.

Welcome to this exceptional Lake Arrowhead mountain retreat, perfectly positioned on a quiet cul de sac with almost a half acre on two lots with beautiful golf course frontage and surrounded by lush, thoughtfully designed landscaping. Offering the ideal blend of rustic mountain charm and comfortable living, this spacious home features four bedrooms, including a stunning primary suite with its own fireplace, plus a versatile loft with built-in bookshelves that adds character and additional living space.
The home showcases beautiful tongue-and-groove walls throughout much of the interior, creating the warm, inviting feel that makes a Lake Arrowhead home so special. A combination of hardwood and carpet flooring complements the mountain-inspired design. The recently constructed redwood decks in the rear provide the perfect setting for entertaining or simply enjoying the peaceful surroundings, complete with a built-in barbecue for effortless outdoor gatherings. Includes a whole house generator, air conditioning and a tankless water heater. This is a great warm lodge style home.
A spacious bonus room with laundry offers flexibility for a game room, office, hobby space, or additional gathering area. With its generous layout, multiple living spaces, distinctive craftsmanship, and incredible setting, there is truly too much to list. 
Best of all, this property includes Lake Arrowhead Lake Rights, giving you access to one of Southern California’s most sought-after mountain communities. Whether you’re looking for a full-time residence, weekend escape, or entertaining retreat, this unique property offers the mountain lifestyle you’ve been waiting for.

results.remarks:
Privately gated on nearly an acre within North Shore Estates, this classic 1930s Lake Arrowhead lakefront estate pairs storybook architecture with beautifully curated interiors. Tucked back from the shoreline for privacy, it overlooks the calm waters of Winter Harbor.
Soaring beamed ceilings, stained glass windows and detailed millwork bring character to generous entertaining spaces. The large kitchen features two Sub-Zero refrigerators, a vintage Viking range and a dining area with a stone fireplace. Five en-suite bedrooms include an expansive primary retreat with a separate living space and fireplace, while an indoor cedar spa room offers another place to unwind.
A single slip dock, stone patio and beach area invite long days by the water. Just above the dock, a 600 square foot party deck and a 138 square foot dock house with a kitchenette, full size refrigerator and powder room create an exceptionally rare setting for lakeside entertaining.
The adjacent lot and additional single slip dock is also available for purchase at an additional cost. Digitally enhanced to show a green front lawn.

results.remarks:
Introducing The Pinecrest Retreat—a refined modern mountain residence set on a coveted corner lot, where thoughtful design meets effortless living beneath a canopy of towering pines. This home does come with lake rights to Lake Arrowhead & has newly installed AC in 2022. Beautifully reimagined with a focus on both style and functionality, this home offers an ideal floor plan with the primary suite located on the main level alongside the kitchen and main living spaces, creating true single-level living rarely found in mountain homes. Downstairs, a spacious secondary family room and two well-appointed guest bedrooms provide the perfect layout for hosting while maintaining privacy and comfort for both owners and guests.

Ideally positioned, the home includes highly sought-after lake rights to Lake Arrowhead and is just a golf cart ride away from the Lake Arrowhead Country Club, offering convenient access to golf, dining, and one of the area’s most desirable lifestyle amenities.

Inside, rich wide-plank wood flooring, vaulted wood-beamed ceilings, and curated finishes create a warm yet elevated atmosphere that feels both inviting and sophisticated. The main living room is anchored by a striking stone fireplace and framed by expansive sliding glass doors that flood the space with natural light and seamlessly connect indoor and outdoor living. The kitchen flows effortlessly into the dining and living areas, making it ideal for everyday living, entertaining, and gathering with family and friends.

The primary suite is a true retreat, offering peaceful forest views, direct access to the deck, and a spa-inspired bathroom featuring dual vanities, a soaking tub, and a custom walk-in shower with designer tile finishes. Every space in the home has been thoughtfully designed to balance comfort, function, and modern mountain elegance.

Outdoors, an expansive wraparound deck unfolds into multiple entertaining areas for dining, lounging, and gathering around the fire, all surrounded by serene natural beauty and mature trees. Whether enjoying quiet mornings or hosting under the stars, this outdoor space delivers the ultimate mountain lifestyle experience.

With its rare combination of layout, setting, and design, The Pinecrest Retreat is more than just a home—it’s a destination, offering the perfect blend of luxury, privacy, and year-round enjoyment in one of Lake Arrowhead’s most desirable settings.

results.remarks:
WALK ACROSS STREET TO YOUR PERSONAL DOCK/BEACH, ENJOY UNOBSTRUCTED LAKE VIEWS, & FULL LAKE RIGHTS.

FROM LEVEL ENTRANCE at 2-car garage, short stairway leads up to the property. Over garage, manicured grassy knoll & concrete deck frame hot tub covered by a custom gazebo. Unobstructed Lake views from two-level home punctuated by 75-foot Douglas Firs & hedge of English Laurel, & custom stone retaining wall framing large, fenced-in backyard - -

WALK DIRECTLY FROM PATIO through 2 sets of sliders reveal primary bedroom, media room/den, and gaming area decorated with chic, whitewashed tongue-and-groove. A sprawling ensuite bedroom hugs a picture window allowing a dappling of soft light to bounce off calming, light grey/blue walls that match the exterior of the home.   A humongous, walk-in closet/dressing room w/custom doors, cabinetry and drawers is accentuated with a flush mounted chandelier.  The bath has double vanity with oversized shower, two rainforest heads and closed-door toilet.  Decor: Varnished knotted hardwood floors, rustic barn doors, an insulated wine cellar, laundry, and large bunk room with its own double-vanity bath - -

THE MAIN FLOOR can be accessed from lower level, w/ floating stairs leading into LR or from an additional road via a wide staircase leading down. This level features a shaded deck for outdoor dining. Inside, mudroom & pantry lead into the kitchen w/large bay window ushering in soft morning sun and amber sunset afternoons.  Gourmet kitchen equipped w/stainless-steel appliances, quartz countertops with faint beige vein, white shaker-style cabinetry, and vaulted ceilings, which all combine to be a chef’s dream.  Wide plank T&G painted white affixed with industrial lighting punctuates a very clean, neutral space for entertaining and serving food - -

Expansive windows span the length of the residence to capture lake & forest.  Angled brick fireplace anchors the room beneath a cathedral ceiling with dark wood beam girders. An open layout and unique cut-out wall dividers maximize natural light throughout, including into two additional oversized bedrooms finished with dark wood, plantation shutters, and custom doors - - 

WATCH BOAT RACES, fireworks, and the "Arrowhead Queen" steamboat, walk directly to your dock & Lake Arrowhead Village.  Parking: space for 3 cars on access road 2-car garage, and room for 3/4 additional cars in front.  See the attached supplemental document for a full list of home improvements.

results.remarks: A rare offering behind the coveted gates of Shelter Cove. Set on approximately 0.68 acres of gently contoured, highly usable land, this 4,000+ sq-ft compound offers lake rights, mature trees, natural landscaping, custom hardscaping, and generous outdoor space. Its peaceful setting provides a welcome sense of privacy while remaining close to some of Lake Arrowhead’s most desirable destinations. Designed for entertaining and relaxed mountain living, the home features elevated furnishings and amenities, including an expansive primary suite, three intimate guest quarters, and a private retreat above the garage. Five updated bathrooms, a refreshed kitchen, a bonus/game room, a 300-square-foot breezeway (included in the overall square footage), and two spacious main-level living areas complete the thoughtful layout. High ceilings, two fireplaces, hardwood floors, abundant windows, and beautiful natural light create an airy yet inviting atmosphere, with ample room to gather, unwind, and enjoy quiet moments. The detached guest suite has its own entrance, making it ideal for visitors, extended stays, a studio, or a secluded workspace. An oversized two-car garage, circular driveway, and abundant parking provide exceptional flexibility for hosting, recreational equipment, storage, or workshop use. Additional improvements include central heating and air conditioning, a security system, and a recently replaced, high-quality composition-shingle roof. Nearly level access places the Lake Arrowhead shoreline trail, Tavern Bay Beach Club, and UCLA Lake Arrowhead Lodge just moments away. Whether the day begins with a walk beneath the pines, an afternoon on the lake, or time spent relaxing with family and friends, the property supports an effortless indoor-outdoor lifestyle in every season. Its combination of privacy, usable land, guest accommodations, and proximity to the water makes it equally suited to full-time living, weekend escapes, and memorable extended stays. Furnishings and A 24-foot Bentley pontoon boat may be included, along with the opportunity to rent or purchase a dock slip, making it easy to enjoy the Lake Arrowhead lifestyle from day one. From summer boating and outdoor entertaining and cozy winter weekends by the fire, this is a home designed to be enjoyed throughout the year. More than a mountain home, this distinctive Shelter Cove estate is a place for gatherings, quiet mornings, and lasting memories. Dock-slip rental is subject to availability/ALA Rules

The most sought after lake side gated community in Lake Arrowhead offering the only 24 hour guard gated access and patrol on mountain including concierge service, 2 private beaches, a private launch ramp, as well as available membership to the on site tennis and pickle ball courts.  This pristine charmer is perched on it's own knoll offering tons of privacy, tree, and peek a boo water views.  It is literally only a 100 yards to your own private boat slip-located in the deepest and calmest water in the North Bay. Paddle boarding and Kyacking are easy, not to mention great fishing! The home has updated windows, paint, baths, kitchen, and hickory flooring not to mention a tremendously sized wrap around deck accessed from the two sliding french doors which allow for fabulous indoor/outdoor entertaining.  There is a primary suite on main level with three additional guest rooms upstairs offering plenty of guest accommodations. The lot is especially large and there is room for future expansion as it is surrounded by multi million dollar lakefront homes and allows for any improvements well spent. Come see this community within a community, also featuring an annual 4th July BBQ and September Trout contest! Let your summer begin! A turnkey opportunity!

Welcome to 747 Brentwood Drive  a true mountain masterpiece , fronting the 6th fairway, this custom-built estate captures sweeping golf course views along with serene vistas of Grass Valley Lake, creating a setting that feels both private and expansive.This one-of-a-kind residence showcases remarkable architectural detail throughout, with a charming exterior that boasts stunning stone and plaster work and a gorgeous slate roof. Inside , rich wood accents, hardwood flooring, limestone and marble flooring, solid hardwood doors, opens to soaring high ceilings, custom beams, and picture windows that speak to the home’s quality and elevate the feel and design.
Spanning three levels, with multiple  decks & patios, offering indoor-outdoor living . The home features 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, highlighted by a luxurious primary suite with ensuite bath and its own fireplace. The kitchen boasts built-in cabinetry that provides ample storage  a gorgeous island provides plenty of space for cooking. The main living area is stunning with it's soaring ceilings and large picture windows to take in the views , complete with a stylish bar and an inviting custom stone fireplace. A large patio off the living room for you to enjoy the views for cocktails ,dinning and relaxing.
The lower level with 2 large bedrooms with ensuite baths leading into a stylish family room, offering a full game room, wine cellar, wet bar and a dedicated spa/jacuzzi room. This level also opens to another large deck & patio, fronting the golf course.
You will appreciate the parking and garage setup which provides for ample parking for yourself and guests includes three separate garages: a main-level garage and an upper-level heated garage large enough to accommodate an RV or boat and a lower-level golf cart garage. The heated driveway ensures year-round convenience.Additional features include three-zone heating and central air, a whole-home speaker system, security wiring, and a recirculating hot water system.
To complete the Lake Arrowhead lifestyle a single slip dock in calm Blue Jay Bay is offered for additional consideration completing the ultimate Lake Arrowhead lifestyle: golf, lake, and mountain living all in one.This is a rare opportunity to own a truly exceptional golf course estate with unmatched amenities, stunning views, and access to one of Southern California’s most sought-after private lake communities. Call to schedule your private viewing .

results.remarks: Set on the desirable north side of Lake Arrowhead, just a short walk or golf cart ride from Tavern Bay, this extensively updated home pairs layered designer finishes with the warmth and character of a classic mountain lodge. Rich wood beamed ceilings, natural light, and a dramatic floor to ceiling stone fireplace give the main living space its character. The updated kitchen, dining area, and living room flow together naturally, creating a home that feels equally suited to quiet weekends and a house full of friends. An oversized deck opens to a flat, fenced yard surrounded by trees, while a separate terrace with a built-in BBQ creates another inviting space for entertaining. The home’s most unexpected feature is its private wellness level, complete with an indoor saltwater pool and spa, sauna, and wine cellar. An elevator connects directly to the primary suite, making morning swims, après lake afternoons, and quiet spa days part of everyday life. Upstairs, the primary suite has its own fireplace and walk-in closet, along with two additional ensuite guest rooms. A fourth ensuite bedroom and two flexible bonus rooms leave plenty of space for an office, gym, media room, playroom, or additional guests. With level entry, a two car garage, rare level grounds, and a location just moments from Tavern Bay, this is a home that makes mountain living feel easy. Beautifully finished, full of character, and designed to be enjoyed in every season.

results.remarks: Imagine waking up as the first light spills across the fairway of the Lake Arrowhead Country Club. Your morning begins with a short stroll down a private path toward the course. Step inside after a morning on the links and you’re greeted by soaring vaulted ceilings and a dramatic fireplace, the kind of living room that feels like a mountain lodge. The newly remodeled kitchen becomes the natural gathering point, with quartz countertops gleaming, stainless steel appliances, and a spacious peninsula. In the afternoon, enjoy a few competitive rounds in the game room or escape up the spiral staircase to a tucked-away sleeping loft. Every corner of this home offers space to spread out and unwind comfortably. As the sun sets, step onto one of three decks overlooking the green. The bubbling spa invites you to unwind. Dinner is served al fresco, the scent of the grill mixing with mountain air. Inside, each bedroom has its own allure: a serene suite with a balcony, a cozy retreat with French doors and sunlit window seating, and bathrooms designed with live-edge wood counters and spa-like soaking tubs. Beyond the home, the generous .30-acre lot gives you space for gatherings, games, or simply enjoying the stillness. Modern comforts include a Tesla charger, built-in speakers, smart home security system, updated lighting, and backup generator hookups. Whether you’re hosting fellow golfers, creating unforgettable weekends with family, or capitalizing on its proven short-term rental success, this property offers more than a place to live. Here, every day feels like a getaway… except you never have to leave.

Don’t miss this magnificently remodeled lake view home, showcasing breathtaking panoramic views from both expansive decks and a dramatic wall of windows that fills the main living space with natural light and unforgettable ambiance. Every inch of this home—inside and out—has been thoughtfully upgraded with exquisite attention to detail.
The design embodies a sophisticated Modern Mountain aesthetic, highlighted by a stunning tuxedo-style kitchen featuring a solid white farmhouse sink, commercial-grade appliances, and a custom iron island. Beautiful LVP luxury waterproof flooring flows throughout, complemented by custom shiplap walls and ceilings that add warmth and character.
All bathrooms have been professionally designed to perfection, including a show-stopping antique chandelier in the primary bath that adds timeless elegance. Additional features include two fireplaces, new windows, auto blinds on most windows, updated electrical wiring, and refinished original ceilings and beams that preserve the home’s charm.
Step outside to enjoy the custom iron railing with a built-in bar on the deck—perfect for entertaining while taking in the serene lake views. Comfort is ensured year-round with a new HVAC system, plus an additional mini-split unit in the primary bedroom.
Custom craftsmanship shines throughout, with both fireplace mantels, the kitchen island, and a downstairs steel and walnut vanity all designed to complement the home’s refined style.
Above the garage, approximately 450 square feet of buildable space offers exciting potential for an additional room or apartment, while a large build-up area provides ample room for a workshop or extra storage.
Offered fully furnished (per seller’s exclusion list), this turnkey home invites you to simply pack your bags and start enjoying the ultimate lake view lifestyle.

results.remarks: With Lake Rights and expansive views across Lake Arrowhead, 1096 Nadelhorn is a design forward mountain home centered around the landscape. Easy, level entry leads directly into the main living space, where prow front architecture and a soaring wall of windows frame the lake and surrounding ridgelines. Vaulted wood ceilings and exposed beams add warmth overhead, while a stone fireplace anchors the open living and dining area. The fully updated kitchen features designer finishes and a cozy breakfast nook (arguably the best seat in the house for morning coffee with a view). Wood paneling in the bedrooms, zellige tiled baths, patterned wallpaper, and warm brass details give each space its own character while keeping the home cohesive. Two bedrooms and a full bathroom are located on the main level, offering added ease and flexibility for guests or anyone who prefers to avoid stairs. Above, the primary suite occupies its own private enclosed loft, with expansive lake views and a level all its own. Downstairs, the mood shifts toward play, with air hockey, Pac-Man, a lounge area, and bar, along with a full bathroom and space for additional guests to entertain. Outside, the decks extend the living space toward the view. Evenings are best spent hanging around the fire, watching the sun set across the lake, or soaking in the hot tub beneath the trees. The property currently holds an active short-term rental permit. While permits do not transfer, San Bernardino County allows continued operation during the ownership transition when the new owner submits a permit application within 30 days of taking title. Buyer to verify all eligibility and requirements with the County. Whether used as a full-time home, weekend retreat, or potential short-term rental, 1096 Nadelhorn is designed for slow mornings, long weekends, and life at the lake.

results.remarks:
The Arrowhead Trail House With Potential Half a Double Dock Available. Beautifully reimagined and fully renovated mountain retreat with Lake Rights, ideally located along the coveted ALA trail with direct access to Lake Arrowhead. This stunning home offers the rare convenience of reaching the lake in under two minutes via a private bridge connecting the property to the lake trail, creating an effortless lake lifestyle.

Inside, the home features 3 spacious bedrooms and 3 beautifully renovated bathrooms, thoughtfully redesigned with modern finishes and timeless mountain style. Nearly every element of the home has been updated, blending clean contemporary design with warm natural textures to create a welcoming and comfortable retreat.

The main living spaces feature wide-plank flooring, custom millwork, and abundant natural light, while the remodeled kitchen offers stylish cabinetry, stone countertops, and stainless appliances—perfect for both everyday living and entertaining.

Downstairs, a dedicated game and entertainment room provides the ultimate gathering space, complete with a pool table and game table, making it ideal for hosting friends and family after a day on the lake or the slopes.

Outdoor living is equally impressive with two large entertaining decks surrounded by mature trees. The lower deck features a private spa and lounge area, creating the perfect place to relax under the stars. From here, a private bridge leads directly to the ALA lake trail, giving you easy access to the shoreline and nearby lakefront.

Additional upgrades include air conditioning for year-round comfort, a rare and desirable feature in mountain homes.

The property also includes full Lake Arrowhead Lake Rights, allowing owners to enjoy the private lake, beaches, and recreational amenities. For boating enthusiasts, a half a double dock located just two minutes away is also available for purchase separately, offering an incredible opportunity to secure immediate lake access.

With its prime trail-side location, extensive renovations, multiple outdoor living spaces, and unbeatable access to the lake, this home offers the perfect balance of luxury, recreation, and mountain tranquility.

results.remarks: Unique free standing townhome and dock offering! Nestled within the coveted enclave of Meadow Bay North, Meadow Bay Townhome Unit 228 offers a rare blend of luxury, privacy, and effortless lakeside living. A special residence in the complex with no shared walls, this beautifully remodeled retreat lives more like a private mountain home, surrounded by mature foliage and peaceful lake views. Completely reimagined from top to bottom, the home showcases exceptional craftsmanship with custom millwork, high-end finishes, and a serene lake-inspired aesthetic throughout. results.remarks: Rare in every sense of the word, this fully FURNISHED and remodeled Lake Arrowhead home is a true mountain retreat. Set on over a half acre DOUBLE LOT, offering the privacy, space, and sense of escape that define elevated mountain living; all just moments from local favorite, Orchard Bay Beach. Every inch has been re-imagined with high-end finishes, custom cabinetry, engineered hardwood floors, and professional design. Even better, the custom furniture and curated decor are included, because they feel perfectly at home here. Enter an open-concept living space laid out for comfort and gathering. A gas fireplace anchors the living room, while a striking modern staircase creates a memorable focal point. The kitchen features custom cabinetry, a custom copper backsplash, and a charming garden window above the sink. Steel French doors open to an expansive deck made for entertaining, from summer barbecues to relaxed evenings in the sunken hot tub beneath the trees and stars. Upstairs, the primary bedroom is a peaceful escape with vaulted ceilings, a large corner window, and a peek-a-boo lake view that can be enjoyed right from bed; it's spacious private balcony offers an added sense of retreat. A central bath feels like a true spa sanctuary, complete with dual sinks, a large walk-in shower, and a freestanding soaking tub set beneath a dramatic geometric picture window that rises to the peak of the vaulted ceiling. Two additional bedrooms on this level enjoy treetop views, while the top-floor loft is a destination all its own. With clerestory-style windows and skylights pouring in natural light, this treehouse room is the kind of space guests remember long after they leave. The lower level offers wonderful flexibility as a recreation room or private guest suite, with steel French doors opening to another large deck plus custom-built media center and a full bath. Nearby, a bedroom or office with stackable laundry adds even more versatility and additional sleeping accommodations. Outside, the show stopping multi-level composite deck is built on a steel substructure, an architectural rarity that speaks to the quality and craftsmanship found throughout the property. Additional highlights include central HVAC, dual-street access, and abundant parking. One entrance is nearly level, making everyday arrivals especially easy. Practical, elegant, and truly unforgettable, this exceptional property also includes coveted lake rights.

results.remarks: Experience the ultimate Lake Arrowhead retreat in this beautifully furnished, modern mountain home showcasing unobstructed, panoramic lake views from nearly every room. Elevated among towering pines, this exceptional property captures sweeping views of Lake Arrowhead, surrounding forested hillsides, and majestic mountain peaks, creating a serene and picturesque setting that can be enjoyed throughout every season. Walls of floor-to-ceiling windows fill the open living spaces with an abundance of natural light while showcasing the spectacular lake views. Soaring vaulted ceilings, beautiful natural wood planking, and striking exposed timber beams add warmth, architectural character, and incredible sense of volume throughout the home. The main living area is designed for both entertaining and relaxing, featuring a dramatic rock fireplace, high wood beam ceilings, a game room, and a stylish entertainment area with bar. Beautifully curated modern furnishings and unique designer lighting fixtures throughout add a sophisticated yet inviting touch. The chef inspired kitchen features stainless-steel-appliances, a dishwasher and a wine fridge and complemented by newer flooring. Dual-pane windows provide comfort and efficiency while maintaining the home's stunning connection to the surrounding landscape. This thoughtfully designed home provides a bathroom for each bedroom, with all the bedrooms conveniently located downstairs. Almost every bedroom enjoys beautiful lake views, creating a peaceful retreat for family and guests alike. The luxurious primary suite is truly a destination of it's own, featuring grand vaulted ceilings, exposed wood beams, a fireplace, an indoor sauna and stunning lake views. Step directly onto the private deck from the primary bedroom and take in the breathtaking scenery. The primary bathroom offers a separate soaking tub, oversized walk-in-shower and a dual-sink vanity. From the sophisticated interiors to the dramatic lake views, towering pines, soaring ceilings, and seamless indoor-outdoor connection, this is a truly special Lake Arrowhead property. A rare combination of modern luxury, breathtaking scenery, and mountain living. Furnishings negotiable. This property is also located on a main county road and offers level entry garage access, making access a breeze, and a coveted feature.

Elevated above the shoreline with commanding views, this fully updated mountain retreat offers a seamless blend of modern style, quiet comfort, and lakeside adventure. It is a home designed not just for living, but for gathering.
Step inside to an inviting, open-concept space where walls of glass frame the deep blue of the lake and the surrounding forest canopy. The kitchen features updated cabinetry and designer countertops, flowing effortlessly into a dining area and a living room anchored by a warm, stone fireplace. One of the home's most tranquil features is its orientation; waking up to lake views from every bedroom provides the perfect excuse to linger over your morning coffee while the mist rises off the water.
The layout is thoughtfully arranged to offer privacy for multi-generational families or larger groups. Along with a convenient bedroom on the main floor, the secondary living level provides a spacious family room with its own fireplace—an ideal retreat for movie nights or extended stays. Outdoor living centers around two expansive decks and a private hot tub nestled among the trees. Set on a larger, more private lot, these spaces offer a premier front-row seat for Lake Arrowhead’s spectacular fireworks displays. results.remarks: Nestled in a coveted first-tier location just minutes from Lake Arrowhead Village, this beautifully remodeled mountain retreat offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and lake lifestyle — complete with a private single-slip dock and direct access to the ALA trail. Surrounded by towering trees and positioned across from the lakefront homes with peek-a-boo lake views, this exceptional property captures the essence of elevated mountain living. Step inside to soaring vaulted ceilings, dramatic prow-style architecture, and expansive windows that fill the home with natural light while framing the serene forest setting. Warm wood tones, custom paneling, and an inviting open-concept floor plan create an ideal environment for both relaxing and entertaining. The spacious living room is centered around an impressive floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace with a custom wood mantle, delivering the perfect mountain ambiance. The thoughtfully redesigned interior features four bedrooms, three full bathrooms, and a large family/game room with its own private entrance leading directly toward the lake trail and dock access. The chef’s kitchen is appointed with premium Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances including a Wolf induction cooktop and double ovens, custom cabinetry, and designer finishes throughout. Additional upgrades include Porcelanosa tile in the bathrooms, new dual-pane windows, luxury vinyl plank flooring, central heating and air conditioning, new gutters, and a stunning RH two-tier cascading antler chandelier that perfectly complements the home’s refined mountain aesthetic. Offered fully furnished with furnishings from RH, Pottery Barn & William Sonoma, this is a true turnkey opportunity. The property also offers dual access with ample parking from both Highway 173 and Blue Lake Road. Despite its convenient location, the home sits privately below the roadway with only a few easy steps to the front door. Whether you are searching for a full-time residence, luxury vacation home, or investment opportunity, this extraordinary Lake Arrowhead property is ready to enjoy immediately — just bring your suitcase and start experiencing lake life.

results.remarks:
Beautifully maintained vintage 1970s cabin, a true time capsule showcasing the craftsmanship, warmth, and character of a bygone era. Rich with old-world touches and preserved in much of its original quality, this special property offers a unique opportunity to own a home that feels both nostalgic and timeless.
Breathtaking panoramic views, enjoyed from nearly every room in the home. From its elevated perch, the property overlooks the lush fairways of the Lake Arrowhead Country Club, the sparkling waters of Grass Valley Lake, and the surrounding mountain landscape.
This cabin features three spacious bedrooms, each with its own en suite bathroom. The main level offers an inviting open-concept living area centered around a cozy fireplace, along with a convenient half bath for guests. The kitchen retains its authentic vintage appeal with original Thermador appliances. Upstairs, the expansive primary suite serves as a private retreat, complete with sweeping views, a wood-burning stove, a comfortable sitting area, and a pull-down projection screen with projector for memorable movie nights in the mountains.
The two lower-level bedrooms open directly onto a large view deck, creating the perfect setting to relax and take in the stunning surroundings. 
While the home's vintage charm remains intact, several important modern upgrades have already been completed, including waterproof carpeting, a newer air conditioning system with all-new ductwork, a whole-house humidifier, and an upgraded electrical panel equipped with two EV charging stations.
This cozy mountain retreat offers the perfect balance of seclusion and convenience. Additional amenities include dual-pane windows, a durable tile roof, a spacious covered carport, a quiet cul-de-sac location, nearby hiking trails, and coveted Lake Rights, providing access to the private waters and recreational amenities of Lake Arrowhead.
Move-in ready and available with most furnishings, this cabin can be enjoyed immediately while also offering the opportunity to add your own personal style over time. Homes with this combination of privacy, character, lake rights, and commanding views of Grass Valley Lake, the golf course, and surrounding mountains are exceptionally rare. While finishes can be updated, these forever views and the irreplaceable setting that comes with them are simply priceless.

Elevated Mountain Living. Nestled within the prestigious community of Cedar Ridge Estates, this beautifully appointed mountain home offers the perfect blend of privacy, comfort, and timeless elegance. Tucked away at the end of a private driveway and surrounded by mature trees, the home offers a peaceful, secluded setting just minutes from everything Lake Arrowhead has to offer.
Designed for both everyday living and effortless entertaining, the thoughtfully crafted floor plan features a spacious main-level primary suite complete with a luxurious en-suite bath and generous walk-in closets. The grand living room welcomes you with soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, and picturesque views of the surrounding pines, flowing seamlessly into the elegant dining area and beautifully designed kitchen.
Just off the kitchen, a dedicated media room complete with a projector creates the perfect space for movie nights and entertaining. Step outside onto the expansive deck, where you're surrounded by a lush mountain landscape, offering exceptional privacy and the perfect setting for morning coffee, outdoor dining, or simply unwinding in the tranquility of the mountains.
The lower level offers three additional bedrooms, along with a versatile bonus room ideal as a workshop, hobby room, or optional fifth bedroom. Wine enthusiasts will appreciate the dedicated wine room, while the organized storage room provides convenient, easily accessible space for seasonal décor, outdoor gear, and more.
Additional amenities include central heating and air conditioning, a whole-house generator, and a level-entry three-car garage with direct access into the home.
Conveniently located just five minutes from Lake Arrowhead Village, the lake, shopping, dining, and nearby Cedar Glen, this exceptional property offers the perfect combination of luxury, functionality, and the best of mountain living.

Welcome to 28001 North Bay Road, Lake Arrowhead - an elevated mountain retreat where refined luxury meets effortless California living. 
Designed with both sophistication and comfort in mind, this residence offers coveted level entry and a sense of exclusivity from the moment you arrive. Inside, the main living space is a striking showcase of volume and warmth, featuring soaring vaulted ceilings, rich hardwood flooring, and a statement wood-burning fireplace that anchors the room with grandeur. Sliders invite seamless indoor-outdoor living, opening to a generous deck that overlooks an expansive fenced yard framed by mature oak trees - an idyllic setting for both intimate gatherings and tranquil mornings.
The kitchen and bathrooms have been thoughtfully reimagined with a sleek, modern aesthetic - blending clean lines, curated finishes, and elevated functionality to create spaces that feel both luxurious and livable. In addition to the living room and kitchen, the main level boasts two bedrooms, a full bathroom and a moody den that offers a cozy escape, complete with a wood-burning stove and a charming artist’s nook - perfect for creative moments or relaxed evenings in. This level is further enhanced by an updated laundry room with a half bathroom.
Upstairs, the inviting primary suite offers a peaceful retreat, complete with French doors that open to a beautifully appointed bathroom featuring a classic clawfoot soaking tub and an oversized walk-in shower. A spacious walk-in closet completes the suite. Just beyond, a loft area provides additional flex space and leads to the generously sized fourth bedroom, which includes its own ensuite bathroom - ideal for guests or extended stays.
Additional features include an attached garage and ample parking, along with recent upgrades such as a new furnace, whole-house water filtration system, main sewer line replacement, automatic generator hookup, and fully updated flooring, kitchen, and baths.
Complete with highly sought-after lake rights and just moments from Tavern Bay, this exceptional property captures the essence of luxury mountain living - where every detail has been curated for beauty, comfort, and ease.

results.remarks: Perched to capture breathtaking lake views, this extraordinary custom home is a rare blend of artistry, history, and craftsmanship—where every detail tells a story.  Engineered and designed for the downstairs primary to be two separate bedrooms for a total of three bedrooms, if 2 huge primary suites aren't enough for your needs.  From the moment you enter, you’re welcomed by rich character and thoughtful design. Underfoot, 150-year-old antique oak floors—reclaimed from Carlisle Harwood—set a warm, timeless tone. Curated lighting throughout the home adds depth and meaning, including Navajo sconces in the half bath, at the entry, and beyond. Descriptive tags at the antique bar further share the story behind these unique pieces. Three stunning chandeliers by artist Lisa Nardone, featured in the Sundance catalog, create an elegant focal point—each one a statement of refined taste.  At the heart of the home, the gourmet kitchen is both beautiful and functional, featuring limestone countertops embedded with fossils, a country sink, self-closing drawers, custom hardware, and a premium Garner BlueStar range. Even the materials invite discovery, with a tile at the bar identifying the specific type of limestone used.  Designed for both comfort and privacy, the residence offers two expansive primary suites. Each full bathroom is appointed with spa-like amenities, including heated floors & steam showers. Three gorgeous split granite stone fireplaces add warmth and ambiance across the living spaces.  Step outside to three redwood decks, perfectly positioned to take in the serene surroundings and sweeping lake views.  Built with an uncompromising commitment to quality, the seller has preserved a book documenting the home’s construction—an enduring testament to the care and craftsmanship poured into every inch.  For those seeking a one-of-a-kind retreat where luxury meets legacy, this home stands truly apart.

results.remarks: Located on one of Lake Arrowhead’s most desirable streets, this exceptional home sits on a quiet and private cul-de-sac along the front nine of the golf course. A circular driveway, level-entry access, and an expansive flat front yard create a rare and welcoming arrival. Nearly the entire home has been thoughtfully remodeled with elevated finishes throughout, including the addition of a tankless water heater and whole-house generator for comfort and peace of mind. Formal entry featuring a newly remodeled powder room, opening into a stunning two-story main living space with white-painted tongue-and-groove ceilings and exposed beams. Walls of oversized sliders flood the home with natural light and showcase sweeping golf course and lake views. The living room is anchored by a striking half-stack stone fireplace with a one-of-a-kind natural wood log mantel and shiplap detail above. The open-concept dining area easily accommodates eight or more guests and flows seamlessly into the newly remodeled kitchen, complete with custom knotty alder hood and island cabinetry, custom-painted cabinets, Fantasy Grey countertops, and a designer backsplash. Just beyond the kitchen, a newly added approximately 200-square-foot mudroom provides an ideal transition from the garage and includes laundry, pantry storage, and a functional workspace. On the opposite side of the main living area, a spacious game room offers a cozy seating area with its own fireplace, bar, and an expansive space perfect for billiards, arcade games, and entertaining. The primary suite is conveniently located on the main level and opens directly onto the deck, offering tranquil golf course views from bed. Spa-like ensuite features dual vanities, a large custom walk-in shower with rain shower head, wall and handheld fixtures, body sprayers, and a built-in bench, along with a generous walk-in closet. Outdoor living is exceptional, with expansive composite decking spanning the entire length of the home and stairs leading down to a flat yard and direct golf course setting. Positioned on the 8th fairway, the property enjoys views of multiple holes and three lakes. Upstairs, guests enjoy private accommodations on each side of the home, featuring oversized bedrooms with large closets, a centrally located bathroom, and a comfortable loft sitting area. A rare combination of privacy, level entry, extensive remodeling, modern systems, and premier golf course and lake views—this is Lake Arrowhead living at its finest.

results.remarks: Enjoy all four seasons in this beautifully remodeled custom mountain home that can be your "getaway retreat”, full-time living, or lucrative short term rental. Located within the highly desirable Lake Arrowhead Woods you will have “FULL LAKE RIGHTS” to boat, fish, or join ALA Beach Clubs. This property’s level entry includes tons of parking to host, friends, and even park an RV if needed. The inviting entryway opens to a spacious living room, dining area, and kitchen. The living room shows off a wall of windows to admire the beautiful colors of fall and watch snow fall in the winter as you enjoy the warmth of a wood burning fireplace. The kitchen features a chef’s stainless kitchen sink, an island that boasts a new LG Signature dual fuel double oven range, and a new quartz counter. Each level of this beautifully updated home includes a fireplace, new waterproof luxury vinyl plank flooring, and higher end Shaw carpet for both style & durability. The main level has a bedroom w/ walk-in closet and a bath w/ vintage clawfoot tub. The master bedroom suite is STUNNING and includes a sitting area and deck to embrace views of the forest. The dual sided gas fireplace will set the mood to unwind in your new 6 foot jacuzzi bathtub. This suite also has a separate walk-in double shower, private toilet rm, and cabinets that show off another new quartz counter. The laundry room is conveniently located outside the master BR suite and down the hall from the office/game room. The owners have invested much to recently add a NEW 3rd level, with private entry, that includes an entertainment room & 4th BR/full bath as a potential "guest quarters". A new roof, large 2-car garage, small playground, LED lighting, & High-Speed internet are EXTRA bonuses. The office/game room could be easily converted to a 5th BR to sleep even more than 10. The convenience of being on a SB County maintained/plowed street (vs an “access road”) during winter is huge. You will truly appreciate this location on the Mtn since you are shaded by majestic dogwood, cedar, and oak trees. Only a short distance to the lake, 5 min. drive to the Village/Restaurants & SkyPark and 24 minutes from Snow Valley Mtn Resort. Price reduced & has NO HOA fees. Could be a turnkey rental/vacation home that is ALREADY UPDATED & NOW FURNISHED. A MUST SEE to appreciate!

results.remarks: Nestled among the towering evergreens of coveted North Bay, this enchanting first-tier/walk-to-the-water mid-century mountain retreat captures the very essence of classic Lake Arrowhead living. With Full Lake Rights and an optional dock slip available for an additional $350,000 (Dock N509A), this is a rare opportunity to embrace the ultimate mountain-and-lake lifestyle in one of the community’s most sought-after locations. Warm, inviting, and filled with character, the home welcomes you with a timeless mountain ambiance highlighted by a dramatic rock fireplace anchoring the open-concept “Great Room” living area. Natural gathering spaces flow effortlessly together, creating the ideal setting for cozy winter evenings, lively entertaining, or peaceful mornings surrounded by the beauty of the forest. Just off the main living area, a separate enclosed patio dining space offers the perfect extension for year-round entertaining, intimate dinners, game nights, or relaxing afternoons immersed in the fresh mountain air. Fresh interior paint and scrumptious new plush carpeting bring a refreshed and luxurious feel throughout the home while maintaining its authentic mountain charm. The flexible floor plan offers 4 bedrooms, 3 baths, plus a den, creating comfortable accommodations for full-time living, weekend escapes, or hosting family and friends. The true primary suite serves as a private sanctuary complete with its own secluded deck — the perfect place to enjoy morning coffee beneath the pines or unwind under the stars after a day on the lake. Outdoors, the inviting rear entertaining area creates an exceptional space for gatherings, outdoor dining, or quiet relaxation beside the spa. Whether hosting unforgettable weekends or savoring peaceful solitude, this property offers the ideal blend of comfort, privacy, and recreation. Additional features include an extra-deep attached garage providing excellent storage for mountain toys, lake gear, and more. Located just moments from the shoreline in a highly desirable walk-to-the-water setting, this special property offers the rare combination of nostalgic Lake Arrowhead charm, modern comfort, and coveted lake lifestyle amenities that are increasingly difficult to find.

Tucked along the calm waters of Winter Harbor, you can boat to Lake Arrowhead Village in minutes. Private, peaceful and connected to the lake, this is true lakefront living.

results.remarks: 177 Shorewood Drive is one of Lake Arrowhead's most exceptional waterfront estates. Set on its own private peninsula and surrounded by water on three sides, it is the only property on the lake with this remarkable setting. With more than 675 feet of private shoreline, two private boat docks, and panoramic views stretching across the centerline of the lake, the Island, surrounding ridgelines, and Lake Arrowhead's iconic Fourth of July fireworks, the estate offers a level of privacy and waterfront access that is truly unmatched. Accessed through a private entry and situated on a rare level peninsula, the home was designed to embrace the lake from nearly every room. Soaring ceilings, expansive windows, and open living spaces are complemented by extensive renovations, including custom stonework, updated baths, premium finishes, and a beautifully appointed chef's kitchen with an oversized butler's pantry and temperature-controlled wine display. The primary suite is a private retreat spanning five distinct spaces: a spacious bedroom, luxurious bath, walk-in closet, breakfast room with coffee bar, and a separate sitting room or office. Wrapped in water views, it offers a rare sense of privacy and tranquility. Throughout the home, thoughtfully designed gathering spaces add warmth and character. An authentic old-world bar and lounge recalls the feel of a classic private club, while an adjoining office and library share the same timeless design, each framed by walls of windows overlooking the lake. A recreation room inspired by a classic 1950s diner offers direct access to the docks, hot tub, and sauna, creating a natural hub for lakefront entertaining. This level also leads to a private wing with four bedrooms and three baths, ideal for hosting family and guests. A separate guest house provides two bedrooms, one-and-a-half baths, a full kitchen, laundry room, and its own private living quarters above two oversized garages and a covered carport large enough to accommodate a boat—perfect for extended family, guests, or a full-time caretaker. Combining an irreplaceable peninsula setting, extensive shoreline, dual docks, exceptional amenities, and timeless design, 177 Shorewood Drive represents a once-in-a-generation opportunity to own one of Lake Arrowhead's most iconic waterfront properties. A detailed and additional amenities list is available upon request.

PRICE IMPROVED — Now $990,000.
Beautifully updated 3,200 sq ft, 5-bedroom, 5-bath luxury retreat on a generous 0.41-acre lot in prestigious Arrowhead Woods. Modern comfort, expansive living spaces, and strong income potential as a fully permitted Short-Term Rental (STR).

Standout Features
• Deeded Lake Rights: private access to Lake Arrowhead, Tavern Bay Beach, beach clubs, boating, and waterfront recreation
• Expansive wrap-around balcony and deck with dramatic pine tree and mountain views
• Game room/den ideal for entertaining, movie nights, or a home office
• Private access road with spacious grounds including park benches, picnic table, and shed (sauna conversion potential)
• Three driveways, 3-car garage with showroom epoxy flooring, plus ample RV parking
• Direct backyard path to elementary school, 2-minute drive to the lake, and 3-minute drive to hospital and fire station
• Easily plowable road with delivery truck access; fully furnished option available.

Interior:
Gourmet kitchen with custom built-ins opens to a great room with fireplace — equally suited to quiet evenings and large gatherings. Primary suite with luxurious bath, jetted tub, and large walk-in closet. Upper level: three additional bedrooms and two full baths. Lower level: bedroom, full bath, and large bonus room (game room, office, theater, or private retreat). Separate laundry for full-size appliances.

Recent Upgrades:
New electrical panel, water heater, central A/C, all major appliances (refrigerator, freezer, stove, dishwasher, wine fridge, washer/dryer), commercial-grade toilets, faucets, sinks, countertops, hot tub, garage epoxy floor, advanced ventilation, basement flooring, ceiling fans, and designer lighting.
Works as a primary residence, multigenerational home, or high-yield vacation rental. Active STR permit plus deeded lake rights deliver both lifestyle and investment value. Just 15 minutes from Lake Arrowhead Village, with world-class hiking, boating, skiing, biking, and off-roading nearby. Spectacular stargazing and mountain serenity. A rare turnkey opportunity — now priced under $1 million.

results.remarks:
Enjoy breathtaking views of the golf course and Grass Valley Lake from this beautifully appointed log-sided mountain retreat. Offering level entry and a two-car garage, this spacious home features an open-concept floor plan designed for both comfortable living and effortless entertaining.

The inviting great room flows into the dining area, highlighted by a stunning custom antler chandelier, while the modern kitchen is equipped with high-end stainless steel appliances, a breakfast bar, and plenty of space for gathering with family and friends.

The downstairs primary suite is a private sanctuary featuring a luxurious spa-inspired bathroom with a double-sided fireplace, soaking tub, separate walk-in shower, dual vanities, and a generous walk-in closet. A large fourth bedroom offers exceptional flexibility and can easily serve as a family or game room, complete with its own wet bar. A convenient stackable washer and dryer are also located downstairs. 2 full baths and one 3/4 bath are also downstairs to accommodate family and guests.

Additional features include beautiful wood flooring throughout, surround sound, and zoned climate control for year-round comfort. The garage has been thoughtfully converted into an impressive game room featuring a custom bar and wine refrigerator, creating the perfect space for entertaining. A large spa is on the lower deck off of the primary bedroom to enjoy the magnificent golf course and lake view!

Comfortably sleeping up to 10 guests, this exceptional property is ideal as a full-time residence, vacation home, or investment opportunity. Furnishings are negotiable, making this mountain getaway move-in ready and waiting for you to enjoy. Lake rights too!

results.remarks: Welcome to this exceptional custom-built West Shore home with Lake Rights. Located a short distance from Tavern Bay Beach Club, this property pairs mountain elegance with a large, level lot, heated 2-car garage, and additional parking, including space for a boat or RV. Designed for both entertaining and everyday comfort, the home features a whole-house music system and a show-stopping chef’s kitchen equipped with a built-in refrigerator, two wine refrigerators, a 5-burner cooktop, double ovens, a large island, two sinks, and a convenient office nook. Warm architectural details shine throughout, including vaulted beamed ceilings, bay windows with seating, rich pine wainscoting, and French doors that open to inviting decks. Four fireplaces add charm and ambiance, while outdoor living is elevated with a built-in jacuzzi and tranquil pond water feature. The incredible primary suite is a true retreat, offering custom built-ins, a dual-sided fireplace, private deck access, and a spa-inspired en suite bath with dual vanities, soaking tub, tiled shower, and walk-in closet. A rare opportunity to own a spacious, amenity-rich Lake Arrowhead home in a premier West Shore location near the lake, beach club, and year-round recreation.

results.remarks: There’s something a little magical about this Lake Arrowhead retreat—the kind of home that feels tucked away from the world, surrounded by towering pines, golden afternoon light and the quiet beauty of the mountains. Offered turn-key furnished, this beautifully updated Prow-style home blends timeless mountain character with modern comfort and features 4 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms and a wonderfully flexible floor plan. The classic Prow architecture is one of Lake Arrowhead’s most beloved designs, and here it shines with soaring wood-beamed ceilings, dramatic walls of glass and an airy great room that feels both grand and inviting. A striking floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace anchors the living space, while expansive windows frame the forest and golf course surroundings and fill the home with natural light. The open layout flows into the dining area and remodeled kitchen with granite slab countertops, custom cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, professional-style range, wine refrigerator, breakfast bar and walk-in pantry. Multiple living spaces make it easy to gather, entertain or simply find a quiet corner to unwind. A dramatic spiral staircase leads to the upper loft, previously used as a bedroom and now transformed into a billiards/game room with its own bathroom. With plenty of space and privacy, it can easily transition back into an additional sleeping area, guest retreat or bonus room. The lower-level primary suite feels like a private escape, complete with fireplace, soaking tub, dual vanities and direct access to the outdoor deck and spa. Additional bedrooms offer generous space for family and guests, including a fun bunk-room setup with excellent sleeping capacity. Outside, multiple expansive decks wrap through the trees, creating beautiful spaces for morning coffee, sunset dinners, long summer evenings and crisp mountain nights. The covered lower deck with spa offers a peaceful place to relax beneath the pines, while the upper decks provide multiple areas for dining and entertaining. Recent improvements include air conditioning, newer carpet, updated lighting and chandeliers, newer blinds, remodeled baths and an extensively updated kitchen. With Lake Arrowhead lake rights, owners can enjoy the private lake, beach clubs, boating, fishing and water sports. Whether you’re searching for a full-time residence, weekend escape or gathering place for family and friends, this special home captures the warmth, nostalgia and beauty of Lake Arrowhead living.
