results.remarks:
Discover the epitome of luxury at this extraordinary estate in beautiful Lake Arrowhead. Nestled on 6.34 private acres adjacent to National Forest trails, this remarkable residence blends timeless elegance with modern sophistication, all surrounded by breathtaking mountain and forest views. Spanning an impressive 9,247 square feet, the home features six spacious bedrooms and seven-and-a-half luxurious bathrooms, including a private upstairs ensuite guest unit complete with its own full kitchen and separate entrance.

Designed for both grand entertaining and comfortable living, the interiors showcase soaring ceilings, expansive windows, and an abundance of natural light throughout. The chef’s kitchen is equipped with premium appliances, generous prep space, and custom finishes, while the formal dining room creates the perfect setting for unforgettable gatherings. Multiple living spaces include a sophisticated main-level den, an inviting game room, and a stunning atrium retreat featuring a hot tub and sauna for ultimate relaxation. Wine enthusiasts will appreciate the custom wine cellar, adding another layer of refinement to this exceptional property.

Outdoor living is equally impressive with expansive decks overlooking the serene grounds, horse stalls, gardens, a tranquil pond, and a fully equipped outdoor kitchen ideal for entertaining under the stars. Additional amenities include air conditioning, laundry area with washer and dryer, and a spacious garage with ample parking. Offering privacy, luxury, and unparalleled natural beauty, this one-of-a-kind estate is a rare opportunity to experience the very best of mountain living in Lake Arrowhead.

Nestled on 6.34 private acres adjacent to National Forest trails, this remarkable residence blends timeless elegance with modern sophistication, all surrounded by breathtaking mountain and forest views. Spanning an impressive 9,247 square feet, the home features six spacious bedrooms and seven-and-a-half luxurious bathrooms, including a private upstairs ensuite guest unit complete with its own full kitchen and separate entrance.

Designed for both grand entertaining and comfortable living, the interiors showcase soaring ceilings, expansive windows, and an abundance of natural light throughout. The chef’s kitchen is equipped with premium appliances, generous prep space, and custom finishes, while the formal dining room creates the perfect setting for unforgettable gatherings. Multiple living spaces include a sophisticated main-level den, an inviting game room, and a stunning atrium retreat featuring a hot tub and sauna for ultimate relaxation. Wine enthusiasts will appreciate the custom wine cellar, adding another layer of refinement to this exceptional property.

Outdoor living is equally impressive with expansive decks overlooking the serene grounds, horse stalls, gardens, a tranquil pond, and a fully equipped outdoor kitchen ideal for entertaining under the stars. Additional amenities include air conditioning, laundry area with washer and dryer, and a spacious garage with ample parking. Offering privacy, luxury, and unparalleled natural beauty, this one-of-a-kind estate is a rare opportunity to experience the very best of mountain living in Lake Arrowhead.

results.remarks: Discover this newly built, stylish two-story contemporary home in the esteemed North Bay area, offering a fresh and inventive approach to mountain living. Positioned on a level corner lot at the end of a cul-de-sac, the home enjoys seclusion under a canopy of immaculate trees. Expansive sliding doors define the entire open-concept design, creating the street-level facade. Features include high beamed ceilings, custom 8-foot doors, a sleek 8-foot wide horizontal fireplace, and a floating staircase, along with a spacious street-level bedroom and full spa bathroom. A natural stone-embedded concrete patio stretches the length of the home's exterior, featuring a Zen garden and a pad for a jacuzzi at the end.Upstairs, four additional bedrooms and two baths offer breathtaking mountain and forest views, complemented by expansive decks. The unique primary bedroom boasts an open floor plan with a custom "loft" style wall separating the bedroom area from a vast walk-in/open closet. The exterior walls, constructed from reclaimed wood, are paired with state-of-the-art products and building materials, including solar panels and automated temperature control. Additional features include an electronic front door and an electric car charger. This energy-efficient smart home stands out as a rare gem in the Mountain Resort Communities of Lake Arrowhead.

results.remarks:
**You’ve seen Lake Arrowhead. Just not quite like this.**

Welcome to 27684 St. Bernard, a mountain retreat that wasn’t simply remodeled, it was **intentionally reimagined **. The result is a home where bold design, thoughtful details and modern comfort meet sweeping lake and mountain views.

Spanning approximately 2,584 square feet across three levels, the home offers five bedrooms, three-and-a-half baths and multiple spaces designed for gathering and retreating. Walls of glass frame the scenery while rich hardwoods and natural wood details bring warmth throughout.

Imported translucent Italian quartzite surrounds the fireplaces in both the main living space and primary suite. Illuminated from behind, the natural movement of the stone comes alive, creating dramatic architectural focal points.

The open-concept kitchen features custom cabinetry, black granite countertops, a statement island and ZLINE Autograph dual-fuel range. Walls of glass connect the living space to the expansive reconstructed composite deck.

**Here, outdoor living isn't an afterthought. It's part of the experience.** Enjoy morning coffee above the trees, long dinners with friends, sunset cocktails and evenings under the stars with Lake Arrowhead as your backdrop.

**The primary suite is a retreat within the retreat**, with its own backlit quartzite fireplace and direct access to the outdoor Jacuzzi spa on the primary bedroom level. The spa-inspired bath features radiant heated floors, custom tilework, frameless glass, dual rain shower heads and a jetted soaking tub.

The intentionality extends beyond what you can see, with new insulation, updated windows and doors, central A/C, Navien tankless water heater, upgraded electrical, EV charging, Leviton smart-home technology with Google Home, and a 14kW Generac whole-home standby generator.

Upstairs, a second living area is joined by three additional bedrooms and a full bath. Two bedrooms open to a private balcony overlooking the lake and mountains.

With lake rights, an attached two-car garage and convenient access to Lake Arrowhead Village, the lake, hiking, dining and skiing, this is a mountain home where the design feels as intentional as the setting.

**Because up here, the house is only part of what you’re buying. The rest is the lifestyle.**

results.remarks:
Experience elevated mountain living at 757 Nadelhorn, where timeless luxury meets effortless comfort. Home offers coveted Lake Rights, level entry, and a thoughtfully designed floor plan with the primary suite on the main level— rare combination in Lake Arrowhead.
From the moment you enter, the home makes a statement. Soaring vaulted ceilings, expansive windows, rich wide-plank flooring, and a magnificent split granite fireplace create a dramatic yet inviting great room.
The chef's kitchen is beautifully appointed with premium Viking appliances, custom finishes, and an open design that flows seamlessly into the dining and living spaces. Every detail has been thoughtfully curated, from the sophisticated lighting to the exceptional designer furnishings. Offered fully furnished (with only a few exclusions), this is far from the typical mountain home. Each piece has been carefully selected to complement the home's refined architecture, creating an effortless, turnkey luxury experience that truly shows like a professionally designed model home.
The main-level primary suite is a true private sanctuary, complete with its own fireplace, generous walk-in closet, and spa-inspired bath. 
The upper deck extends the living space outdoors, forest views, a fire pit, and the perfect setting for entertaining.
The lower level is equally impressive, featuring four spacious guest bedrooms, including a Jack-and-Jill suite, an additional full bath, and an inviting family room centered around a second spectacular split granite fireplace—creating a warm and elegant gathering space. Step outside to another deck complete with a private spa, fire pit, and oversized swing, surrounded by trees. Above the garage, an exceptional private entertainment lounge elevates the home's appeal, creating the ultimate destination for hosting family and friends. Designed for memorable gatherings, the space features a custom bar, pool table, shuffleboard, and a classic arcade game, offering the perfect blend of sophistication and fun.  It also offers endless possibilities as a private art studio, fitness room, executive office, or creative workspace, making it as functional as it is impressive.
Additional luxury amenities include air conditioning, a whole-house backup generator, updated flooring and finishes throughout, abundant parking, generous garage storage, and a whimsical treehouse tucked among the trees.

Beamed ceilings add warmth and architectural appeal, while the spacious living area features a beautiful stone fireplace that creates a welcoming focal point and gathering space. The open-concept kitchen includes a Bertazzoni gas convection oven and opens to the dining and living area to provide an easy flow for everyday living and entertaining. Large floor-to-ceiling windows and sliding doors fill the interior with natural light and open to the perfectly manicured backyard. The thoughtful layout offers comfortable spaces for both relaxing and entertaining, while central heating and air conditioning provide year-round comfort. A spacious attached 2-car garage and two paved driveways provide ample parking and added functionality. The property also features a Generac generator, providing added peace of mind, along with a large powered shed ideal for hobbies, projects, or additional storage. Outdoor spaces offer a wonderful setting to enjoy the peaceful wooded surroundings and fresh mountain air. Ideally located near Lake Arrowhead Village and close to hiking, biking, golf, dining, shopping, and other year-round mountain recreation, this inviting home includes lake rights so you can enjoy the beauty and character of the Lake Arrowhead lifestyle.

Welcome to an exceptional Lake Arrowhead retreat where timeless mountain character meets an extensive, thoughtfully curated remodel—complete with lake rights. From the moment you enter, soaring wood-beamed ceilings, walls of windows, and a dramatic floor-to-ceiling herringbone fireplace create a warm yet elevated mountain atmosphere. The beautifully appointed kitchen offers generous workspace and KitchenAid appliances, while the charming eat-in nook feels like dining among the trees. A formal dining area and multiple decks make the home equally suited for quiet weekends or gathering with family and friends.

Designed with flexibility in mind, the home offers two primary suites and multiple living spaces across three levels. The main level includes a bedroom with walk-in closet and full bath. Upstairs, the private primary retreat features a spa-inspired bath and adjoining office or lounge. The lower level creates an ideal guest or multi-generational space with a second primary suite, additional bedroom and bath, spacious living area with fireplace, wet bar, covered deck, and private patio.

Extensively remodeled and meticulously maintained, the home reflects quality and attention to detail throughout. Features include rare 2x6 construction and copper-capped beams, Andersen windows and doors, solid brass Baldwin hardware, Restoration Hardware lighting, solid oak flooring, custom window coverings, updated insulation, cedar and concrete siding, copper plumbing, updated electrical, a 50-year roof, LeafFilter gutters, whole-house Generac generator, multiple furnaces and water heaters, and a grand mudroom.

Outside, mature pines, maples, dogwoods, fruit trees, and seasonal blooms create a peaceful mountain garden setting with brick pathways and a covered timber pavilion. An oversized two-car garage, boat parking, heated workshop, and more than 1,000 sq ft of storage provide exceptional space for mountain toys, hobbies, recreation, and everyday living.

Located directly across from Lake Arrowhead Country Club, near Grass Valley Park, and on a maintained road for convenient year-round access, this property offers the versatility of a full-time residence or an unforgettable second-home retreat. And with lake rights, the Lake Arrowhead lifestyle is yours to enjoy.

Optional North Shore boat slip available separately.

Whether hosting summer gatherings or enjoying peaceful weekends in the pines, this property was designed for making lifelong memories.

results.remarks: Imagine starting your day surrounded by tall pines, watching golfers play through the fairway below as the mountain wakes up. Located on the 6th green of Lake Arrowhead Country Club, this beautifully renovated home offers true golf course frontage with views stretching across multiple holes and of Grass Valley Lake, creating a front-row seat to one of the most sought-after lifestyles in the mountains.Inside, the home feels warm and welcoming, with vaulted ceilings, large windows framing the golf course, and natural materials throughout. The main living spaces are designed for everyday living and entertaining, centered around a stone fireplace and wall of glass overlooking the fairway. The kitchen and dining areas flow from the living room and feature an oversized marble island, Sub-Zero refrigerator, four Wolf ovens, and a Cove dishwasher. These brands, along with RH, Arhaus, Schoenboch, and Kolher, are the high end finishes that blend functionality and beautiful design that make this space special. Just off the main living area, the main level primary suite offers access to the expanded deck, golf course views, vaulted ceilings, and a stone fireplace. The spa-inspired bathroom features heated floors, a bidet toilet, soaking tub, illuminated opal white granite bathtub wall, multi headed shower with body jets, and walk-in closet. 2 additional full bedroom suites are spread throughout the home for privacy and flexibility. Upstairs features one of those primary suites with a fireplace, 4 piece bathroom, and lofted work or play area. Completing the street level is a wellness space complete with a 2 person Clearlight sauna and yoga studio with ceiling anchors for aerial suspension. The lower level is ideal for entertaining, offering a game and lounge area with stone fireplace, poker nook, and additional bedrooms, including the third ensuite with patio access. Outdoor living truly sets this home apart, with over 1,000 square feet of weatherproof tile deck space overlooking the fairway, plus a lower golf-level patio and new salt water jacuzzi just steps from the course. A two-car garage and separate golf cart garage complete the property, with direct access to a private golf cart path leading straight out to the fairway. With true golf course frontage, lake rights, and close proximity to Lake Arrowhead Village and the lake, this home brings together golf, lake, and mountain living in one setting. Furnishing and brand new 4 person golf cart included with purchase.

The SkyStone LakeHouse. Welcome to luxurious lake living in the exclusive, guard-gated community of Point Hamiltair—Lake Arrowhead’s most prestigious and sought-after enclave. Known for its 24/7 security, concierge services for home upkeep, and a long-standing legacy of celebrity and socialite residents, this community offers the ultimate in comfort, privacy, and prestige. Located directly across from a $12 million estate and just a short stroll or golf cart ride to your private boat slip, this exquisitely remodeled lakeview home blends timeless mountain charm with top-tier modern upgrades—offering a true turnkey lifestyle.

From the moment you arrive, you’re greeted by breathtaking lake and tree views framed by soaring high-beam A-frame ceilings and an iconic wall of windows. Natural light pours into the open-concept living space, where wide plank European white oak floors and a floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace create the perfect balance of warmth and sophistication. The spacious living area is ideal for entertaining, with abundant seating to relax and soak in the views.

The gourmet kitchen is a designer’s dream, featuring marble countertops, custom cabinetry, a show-stopping Ilve Italian range, European fixtures, and a convenient pass-through shelf that connects directly to the expansive outdoor dining area. Step outside to your wrap-around deck, thoughtfully designed with multiple lounge and dining zones, a built-in BBQ area, and serene spaces to enjoy al fresco meals beneath the stars.

The main-level primary suite is a tranquil retreat with a walk-in closet and spa-inspired ensuite bathroom, complete with marble counters, a custom tile steam shower, and luxury plumbing fixtures. Upstairs, two bright guest bedrooms with vaulted ceilings share a stylish full bath with a walk-in shower and designer vanity. The lower level offers a brick-floored entertainment lounge with a second fireplace, wet bar, game area, ¾ bath, and direct access to the fenced yard and lower patio.

Additional upgrades include a new roof, rebuilt decks and railings, exterior stonework, concrete walkways, professional landscaping, and a subterranean sprinkler system. Offered beautifully furnished (furniture negotiable), this lake view masterpiece is ready to enjoy. A rare opportunity to own in one of Lake Arrowhead’s most iconic and luxurious communities.
